summary.en: Israeli forces demolished houses in southern Lebanon, withdrew and allowed villagers to return to damaged homes while Lebanese President Aoun warned Israel to pull back and cautioned Iran against interference. An IDF spokesperson visited a Lebanese school, sparking outrage and prompting an analyst to warn the move could push Lebanese Christians toward Hezbollah. Israel publicly sent best wishes to Lebanon on its Independence Day, which was observed quietly amid muted celebrations and ongoing drone activity over Beirut and strikes on southern Lebanese towns. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker revet ned hus i sørlige Libanon, trakk seg tilbake og tillot landsbyboere å gå tilbake til skadede hjem, mens Libanons president Aoun advarte Israel om å trekke seg og advarte Iran mot innblanding. En talsperson fra IDF besøkte en libanesisk skole, noe som vekket oppsikt og fikk en analytiker til å advare om at handlingen kan drive libanesiske kristne mot Hizbollah. Israel sendte offentlige beste ønsker til Libanon på landets uavhengighetsdag, som ble markert stille med dempede feiringer og pågående droneaktivitet over Beirut og angrep på sørlige libanesiske byer. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
